methodology.ma: SMA of last 5/10/20 daily, weekly or monthly closes; top-level also SMA60 daily. At least 20 bars for classification: Close>MA5>MA10>MA20=多头; reverse=空头; otherwise 震荡. Strict inequalities. return20SessionsPct=(close/close20 observations ago-1)*100; changePct uses previous observation.
methodology.macd: DIF=EMA12-EMA26; DEA=EMA9(DIF); histogram=2*(DIF-DEA). Price EMAs start at first close, DEA at first DIF (0). Publish after 26 bars, previousHistogram after 27; DIF>=DEA=偏多, otherwise 偏空. Compute using all fetched observations, without intermediate rounding.
methodology.rsi: Wilder RSI14: initial average gain/loss over first 14 changes, then (previous*13+current)/14. Needs 15 closes (previousRsi needs 16). No losses=100; no gains=0; flat=50. >=70 超买; <=30 超卖; otherwise 中性.
methodology.aggregation: Chronological daily closes, last actual observation per ISO Monday-Sunday week (ending Friday close) or calendar month; no forward filling. asOf is actual last observation, count is available period bars. complete requires period end <= requested asOf and retrieval after 15:00 Asia/Shanghai on end date; current unfinished week/month=false. Month ends on last calendar day; no holiday-calendar inference. Cutoff removes future observations. limited=true if any period indicator or previous value is unavailable; unavailable fields are null.
methodology.sources: Fresh direct requests only. ETFs: Tencent web.ifzq.gtimg.cn/appstock/app/fqkline/get, day from 2021-01-01 through cutoff, up to 640 bars; prefer qfqday, fallback to day. Historical cutoff uses provider current adjustment basis. Funds: fund.eastmoney.com/pingzhongdata/<code>.js Data_ACWorthTrend, published accumulated NAV (unit NAV plus cumulative distributions), NOT estimated NAV and NOT a compounded dividend-reinvestment total-return series. Daily indicators/returns for funds use this accumulated NAV basis throughout. navDate/asOf identify the latest published NAV valuation date; publication timestamp is not supplied by this endpoint. retrievedAt is actual fetch completion time. Top-level asOf is requested cutoff; record dates may lag it. Failures are errors, never substituted with cached data. Output stores indicators only, no raw K-lines.
